## 1. Architectural Diagnosis: Why Previous Layouts Failed

On standard **1440×900** (MacBook Pro 14"/16") and **1280×800** viewports, the previous dual-shell system failed across three critical dimensions:

1. **Vertical Chrome Tax (~120px lost)**:
   - Outer `DashboardShell` header (56px) stacked on top of inner `TestbenchShell` header (64px) consumed nearly 15% of vertical screen real estate before a single line of AST or JSON rendered.
2. **Horizontal Chrome Tax (~460px lost)**:
   - Combining the expanded Main App Sidebar (240px) with the vertical Checkpoint 0–5 Rail (220px) left only **820px** of width on a 1280px screen.
   - A 3-column workbench inside 820px yielded only **273px per column**, triggering severe horizontal clipping and truncated JSON/SQL blocks.
3. **Unbounded Flex Row Overflow**:
   - Rendering 10+ independent status pills (`Novel Selector`, `Contract Hash`, `R2`, `Supabase`, `Turso`, `Swarm Status`, `Worker Count`, `Boot`, `Manage`, `Kill`, `Stop All`) in a flat `flex-row` required **~1,680px** of minimum intrinsic width.
   - On screens `<1600px`, the right-most items—specifically **Turso**, **VM Swarm**, and **Panic Kill**—clipped off screen.

### A. Eliminating Dual Sidebars: Auto-Collapsed 56px App Rail + 38px Pipeline Ribbon
- **Main App Sidebar $\to$ 56px (`w-14`) Icon Rail**:
  - When matching `/testbench/*`, `DashboardShell` collapses primary navigation into a fixed 56px icon rail.
  - Hovering reveals instant tooltips; clicking opens an overlay drawer without pushing the workbench.
- **Checkpoint Switcher $\to$ 38px Horizontal Pipeline Ribbon**:
  - Checkpoints 0 through 5 are organized as a horizontal ribbon directly below the Command Bar.
  - Frees **220px of permanent horizontal width** for all deep 3-column test tools.
  - Directional progression (`──>`) with live status indicators (Passed `●`, Running `◉`, Failed `▲`, Idle `○`).

### B. Eliminating Dual Headers: 48px Unified Command Bar with 3 Deterministic Flex Zones
1. **Left Zone: Context & Verification (Fixed ~340px)**
   - Scriptoria breadcrumb (`Testbench /`)
   - Novel selector dropdown (`w-48` / `w-56`)
   - Interactive `ContractHashBadge` pill (`#c84f1a` Verified / Drift)
2. **Center Zone: Infrastructure Telemetry Cluster (Consolidated Popovers)**
   - **Cloud Storage & DBs (`[● R2 ● PG ● Turso ▾]`)**: Single badge with color dots. Clicking reveals latency, object counts, and WAL sync status.
   - **VM Swarm Cluster (`[⚡ Swarm 16/16 · 420 t/s ▾]`)**: Real-time worker allocation, queue depth, throughput gauge, and Boot/Scale controls.
3. **Right Zone: Emergency Actions (Fixed ~140px)**
   - High-contrast `⏹ STOP ALL` panic button anchored to the right margin with `shrink-0`.

## 3. Layout Anatomy for All 6 Test Pages

### Tab 0: Plumbing & Storage Lake (2-Column 5/7 Grid)
- **Column 1 (5 cols / ~42%)**:
  - Drag-and-drop novel ingestion dropzone (`.epub`, `.txt`, `.md`, SHA-256 verification).
  - Virtualized R2 Object Tree (`00_raw/`, `01_ast_chunks/`, `02_extractions/`, `03_graph_snapshots/`) with byte-range header preview.
- **Column 2 (7 cols / ~58%)**:
  - Infrastructure Smoke Test Matrix (R2 Storage, Supabase pgvector, Turso libSQL, Contract Registry) with pass/fail latency badges.
  - Schema Fault Injector & Chaos Deck (inject lone UTF-8 surrogates, out-of-bounds byte spans, Turso quorum timeouts, contract hash mutations, and Dead-Letter Queue / DLQ verification).

### Tab 1: Deterministic Parser Inspector (3-Pane Split View: 3 / 6 / 3 Cols)
- **Pane 1 (3 cols / 25%)**: Dual-Span AST Hierarchy (Book $\to$ Chapter $\to$ Paragraph $\to$ Sentence with dual coordinates `[B:18420..18912 | C:18104..18590]`).
- **Pane 2 (6 cols / 50%)**: Source & Chunk Boundary Canvas with chunk overlap window indicators (`══════ CHUNK #088 OVERLAP WINDOW ══════`) and highlighted entity tokens.
- **Pane 3 (3 cols / 25%)**: Ligature & Offset Drift Radar with exact byte-span vs char-span matrix, multi-byte drift readout (+316 Bytes), and NFC ligature replacements (`ﬂ` $\to$ `fl`, `ﬁ` $\to$ `fi`).

### Tab 2: VM Swarm & Extraction Inspector (Top Strip + 3-Column Split)
- **Top 40px Strip**: Swarm Worker Matrix (`W01` through `W16` color badges), Active Job ID, TTFT (164ms), throughput.
- **Column 1 (4 cols)**: Raw Chunk & Prompt Context (sliding window entities, token count, byte boundaries).
- **Column 2 (4 cols)**: Live LLM Token Stream & SSE Reasoning Trace with live character cursor.
- **Column 3 (4 cols)**: Strict Schema Validation & Staged DB Upsert Preview with byte-span substring assertion (`raw[start:end] === text`).

### Tab 3: Graph & Timeline Studio (Scrubber + 2-Column Split)
- **Left Dock (280px / 320px)**: Entity & Location Registry with search filter, alias index, mention count, and connectivity degree.
- **Center Canvas (Flex-1)**: Interactive SVG/WebGL Node-Link Canvas with color-coded relation links and floating HUD Node Inspector.
- **Bottom Scrubber (h-48 / 12rem)**: Dual Timeline Scrubber:
  - Track A (Discourse Order): Linear manuscript chapter sequence (`[Ch.01] ── [Ch.05] ── [Ch.10] ── [Ch.30]`).
  - Track B (Chronological Story Time): Narrative universe timeline with analepsis (flashbacks) and prolepsis (flash-forwards).

### Tab 4: Hybrid RAG Workbench (Top Deck + Bottom 3-Column Comparison)
- **Top Deck**:
  - Hybrid query input with $\alpha = 0.65$ dense/sparse slider.
  - Safe Read-Only SQL Console with strict AST Guard (rejects mutations, executes with `EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN`).
  - Storage & Index Telemetry Gauge (Turso libSQL DB footprint, DiskANN 1536-dim vector index size, FTS5 inverted index size).
- **Bottom 3 Columns**:
  - Column 1: Sparse Lexical (FTS5 BM25) top hits with term highlighting.
  - Column 2: Dense Vector (DiskANN Cosine) top hits with semantic similarity scores.
  - Column 3: Fused Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF, $k=60$) deduplicated ranking with rerank trajectory badges.

### Tab 5: E2E Pipeline Stepper & QA Regression Scorecard
- **Top Panel (h-24)**: 5-Stage Visual Stepper (`Ingest & R2` $\to$ `AST & Chunks` $\to$ `VM Swarm` $\to$ `Graph & Time` $\to$ `Hybrid RAG`) with live step latency and status.
- **Bottom Left Panel (7 cols)**: 15 Edge-Case QA Regression Scorecard table covering EC-01 through EC-15 with invariant assertion descriptions, stage, metric, and PASS/FAIL badge.
- **Bottom Right Panel (5 cols)**: Assertion Diff & Evidence Inspector displaying exact failure details and a 1-click **Jump to Checkpoint @ Chunk** deep-link button.
